title: Governance-State Corruption in Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents: A Cross-Model Stress Test
abstract: arXiv:2610.30698v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An LLM agent can retrieve a memory correctly yet use it incorrectly after its validity state changes. We study governance-state corruption: faults that alter which retained records enter model-visible context while stored content and tasks remain fixed. Across six providers, 731 benchmark-grounded bases yield 2,080 matched fault pairs. In offline control-plane checks, corruption changes the operative projection in 96.25% of pairs, while oracle-backed enforcement restores it in 100%. For downstream evaluation, a deterministically selected, non-probability LongMemEval/Memora panel resolves 298 of 300 matched triplets (238 distinct bases). Clean-minus-corrupted contrasts are 40.54 percentage points in LongMemEval binary correctness (95% base-cluster interval [30.32, 50.71]) and 30.60 points in rescaled Memora FAMA ([23.31, 37.69]); both sources also show recovery. OAKS Novel native option parity holds for all 6,714 resolved outputs. Full-

translated_title: 面向大语言模型智能体长期记忆的治理状态损坏：一项跨模型压力测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：一个LLM智能体能够正确检索记忆，却可能在其有效性状态发生变化后错误地使用它。我们研究“治理状态损坏”：即在存储内容和任务保持不变的情况下，改变哪些留存记录进入模型可见上下文的故障。在六个模型提供商中，731个基于基准的基础案例产生了2,080个匹配的故障对。在离线控制平面检查中，损坏在96.25%的配对中改变了有效投影，而基于oracle的治理强制执行在100%的情况下将其恢复。在下游评估方面，一个确定性选择的非概率LongMemEval/Memora面板解决了300个匹配三元组中的298个（涉及238个不同的基础案例）。干净与损坏条件下的对比在LongMemEval二元正确性上达到40.54个百分点（95%基础聚类置信区间[30.32, 50.71]），在重新缩放的Memora FAMA上达到30.60个百分点（[23.31, 37.69]）；两个数据源均显示恢复效果。OAKS的原生选项对等性在所有6,714个已解决的输出中均保持成立。
tldr: 该论文定义并量化了一类新故障“治理状态损坏”——即在存储内容不变时仅改变哪些记忆记录进入模型上下文的故障，通过跨六个提供商的2,080对故障实验证明此类损坏可使LLM智能体下游性能下降高达40个百分点，而基于oracle的治理强制执行能实现100%恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper defines and quantifies "governance-state corruption," a novel fault class that alters which retained memory records enter model-visible context while stored content remains fixed, demonstrating across six providers that such corruption degrades LLM agent downstream performance by up to 40 percentage points, while oracle-backed governance enforcement achieves 100% recovery.
